# Talking points for patrons

Short answers for desk staff after the end of [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]].

- **Why did you stop charging?** Charges kept people away, mostly families and students, and did not make books come back faster. See the [[Pilot results - Pinecrest no-charge summer#Patrons who came back]].
- **Can I get my money back?** No. Charges paid before April 1, 2026 are not refunded.
- **So I can keep books forever?** No. After 45 days an item is billed as lost, and holds still have to be picked up within a week.
- **Do other libraries do this?** Many do. Interlibrary loan items still follow the lending library's rules.
